messages:
ruth_pm: Dropped a fresh compact-rail mock for the Usage page: https://www.figma.com/file/new/usage-compact-rail (frame: 'Landing - Compact Rail'). Quick ask: does the compact rail with an org billing pill + project micro-cards communicate scope clearly enough?

noah_design: The compact rail packs top 5 projects into a single horizontal strip under an org billing pill. The pill shows MTD total + small download badge. Hover expands pill to show credits and discounts. Trying to keep vertical real estate tiny.

elliot_eng: Love the space savings. Implementation note: the pill hover should not trigger heavy backend calls. Prefetch summary at page load; expand lazy-loads the route-level CSV only when requested.

mira_billing: Ops note: invoices are issued at org level. The pill download badge needs to explicitly say 'Org invoice (PDF)'. Project micro-cards should never promise separate invoices. If a user clicks a project action that implies invoice, open a modal that clearly states data is from the org invoice with project context.

tara_a11y: Accessibility checklist: 1) billing pill must be a semantic button with aria-haspopup when it opens details. 2) the download badge must have an aria-label like 'Download organization invoice for March 2026'. 3) the horizontal rail must be keyboard scrollable and each card focusable. 4) any hover-only affordance must have an accessible alternative.

noah_design: I'll switch the pill to a button and add keyboard affordances. Thinking of a micro-copy change: pill text -> 'Org charges: $X (MTD) · Download org invoice'. Is that too wordy?
ruth_pm: I prefer shorter: 'Org charges: $X' with a separate compact 'Download' icon button that has descriptive aria-label. Keeps visual density lower.

elliot_eng: For project micro-cards, show three inline metrics: Estimated charges (pre-tax), tokens, and top model. Add a kebab menu per card with 'View billing context' that opens the modal Mira described. Kebab must be in DOM but visually minimal.
mira_billing: In modal, primary action should be 'Download org invoice (PDF)'. Secondary action: 'Export ledger (CSV)' behind RBAC and with a warning "Includes route-level details". If user lacks billing role, show 'Request export' that opens a ticket.
tara_a11y: Modal requirements: trap focus, close with Esc, provide a visible close button with aria-label. Associate the CSV warning using aria-describedby. Make the CSV link a native anchor so screen readers announce file type.

noah_design: UX question: show token breakdown inline in micro-card or provide an accordion in the modal? Inline is denser but faster for casual checks. Modal keeps landing clean.
elliot_eng: Inline summaries (tokens total + % change) are cheap. Route lists and per-route costs should live in modal and be paginated. Backend will expose a paged ledger endpoint and async export jobs.
ruth_pm: Also product request: add a tiny toggle on the modal header for 'Percent / Absolute tokens' for auditors. Make sure toggle updates SR text.
tara_a11y: Toggle must use role="switch" or a native checkbox and update an aria-live region with "Showing token breakdown as percentages" or similar.

mira_billing: Another ops ask: show an estimated export size and ETA after user clicks Export (e.g., "Preparing CSV — ~120s, ~45k rows"). That helps set expectations for large orgs. Also show a progress spinner and optionally stream results.
elliot_eng: We'll implement export as a job that returns job_id; frontend will poll and render progress. For large orgs, stream a zipped CSV. We'll include a filesize estimate from the job start response.

noah_design: small accessibility/color nit: status badges on the pill (under/over budget) currently use low contrast greens. I'll push contrast darker and increase weight for legibility.
tara_a11y: Thanks, also run a quick color-blindness pass (deutan/protan) once updated. Ensure badges aren't color-only: include an icon or text.

ruth_pm: Final UX constraint: keep initial landing height under ~1200px on 1440w laptops (roughly 3 vertical folds). If the compact rail plus pill grows beyond that, collapse the rail to a 'Show projects' affordance. Call out any layouts that break the rule in figma comments.

noah_design: Will iterate and post a revised link. Also added analytics events: pill_download_click, modal_open, export_requested, export_complete. Keep them debounced.
elliot_eng: small perf ask: avoid rendering all micro-cards for orgs with >200 projects. Render top 5 by spend, provide 'See all projects' link to full grid (paginated). Server can return top_projects array.
mira_billing: Copy tweak: change 'Est charges' -> 'Estimated charges (pre-tax)'. Legal asked for explicitness.
ruth_pm: Action items: Noah update pill/button and contrast + post new figma (EOD); Elliot spec lazy-load + export job + paginated ledger (PR next week); Mira finalize RBAC copy and export warning; Tara do a11y smoke test after updates. Notes-bot: add design-review on calendar for Monday 11:00 UTC.

notes-bot: Design review scheduled Monday 11:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar_pad:

ruth_pm: Thanks team. Closing thread for now — ping here if anyone finds a blocker.
